Class MessageFindCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.MessageFindCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public class MessageFindCommand extends Object implements Command
The MessageFindCommand type is the message find command. One form looks up a Roux identity pair, written as a high half and a low half. Roux is the store that holds the conversation messages. The other form lists every message whose text contains a substring. The command has no aliases.

    • execute

      public void execute(CommandContext ctx, String args) throws Exception
      The execute method finds one message by identity or several messages by text. If args is null or blank, the method throws Exception with the usage that names both forms. If the trimmed text is by, or starts with by , the rest is the substring search. stripQuotes(String) removes one matching quote pair from that substring. If the substring is empty, the method throws Exception with the message Usage: message find by <text>. Otherwise findByText(CommandContext, String) lists the matches. The identity form requires two whitespace-separated tokens. If either token is not a decimal long, the method throws the two-form usage exception. If ChatSession.inspectById(long, long) returns null, the method throws Exception with the message No message with that id. A found card is printed by MessageShowCommand.writeCard(CommandContext, MessageInspect).
      Specified by:
      execute in interface Command
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The usage was wrong, or no message has that identity.

    • findByText

      private void findByText(CommandContext ctx, String needle)
      The findByText method lists messages whose text contains a substring. The comparison is case-insensitive. Sequence numbers run from one through the current message count. A null inspect result is skipped. A null text is treated as empty. Each hit writes [, the sequence number, ] , the role name, : , and the text cut by MessageListCommand.truncate(String, int). The preview cap comes from MessageListCommand.previewCap(CommandContext, boolean) with verbose off. If no message matches, the method writes No messages containing that text. Each line ends with a carriage return and a line feed.
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      needle - The substring to find.

    • stripQuotes

      private static String stripQuotes(String raw)
      The stripQuotes method removes one matching quote pair from a search string. The pair is removed only when the text has at least two characters and both ends are ' or both ends are ". Any other text is returned unchanged.
      Parameters:
      raw - The search text, which may be quoted.
      Returns:
      The text without one matching quote pair, or the original text.
